**Limitations**

- Simplified, so it falls short of the full BM3D, which uses other transforms, a Kaiser window and an opponent color space.
- Slow in Python on large images.
- Assumes white Gaussian noise of one known level.

**Artifacts**

- Faint blocky patterns in flat areas at high noise.
- Smoothed fine texture when sigma is set too high.
